support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs treating the registry link as unresolved while noting a separate Wyoming LLC candidate.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity beyond name similarity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; the commercial notes preserve multiple live registry candidates and explicitly state that identity cannot be established, so neither burden is met and UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
